selection_rule: Purposive six-document pilot spanning authoritative rules, current operating projections, drought response, infrastructure/hydropower, storage capacity, and decision modeling; all records are core, usable, and KU-ready.
sampling_note: This is a coverage-oriented pilot set, not a probability sample of the full corpus. Freeze page/section packets and content hashes before method execution.
exclusions: Tier C and failed/needs-recovery records are excluded from the first method pilot; test them later as a robustness stratum.
